newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks flat as resistance remains intact.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks flat as resistance remains intact.

text.p: Argentine stocks finished flat to slightly lower Monday after the market's push above resistance was followed by profit-taking.
The leading Merval blue chip stock index rose as much as 0.70 percent to briefly trade above the 610 mark but was knocked lower to finish 0.01 percent down from Friday at 606.96 index points.

"Although the economic conditions continue being optimistic, one can see certain market obstacles even if the market broke its highest levels of last week," said Jorge Bonanno, an analyst at Interfin consultancy.
The market did not break resistance at 610 last week.

The market's early rise was helped by more evidence of rising growth, such as the release by the Economy Ministry Monday of industrial production figures for October showing a yearly rise of 12.5 percent.
Among the main gainers this session were cement maker Juan Minetti which rose by 3.23 percent and Banco Galicia which advanced by 1.90 percent.
Decliners were led by energy firm Central Puerto which fell 2.24 percent. Of the 63 stocks traded this session, 24 rose, 21 fell and the rest remained unchanged.
